name: Mohammad Shaukat Ali
bio:
Mohammad Shaukat Ali is a visiting PhD Researcher in the MGB group, working on the structural characterisation of bacterial defluorinating enzymes. His research combines homology modelling, binding-site analysis, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations to investigate how active-site flexibility and substrate positioning influence carbon–fluorine bond cleavage in FAcD, HAD, and other catabolic enzymes. His work supports the group’s enzyme screening efforts to understand and identify microbial mechanisms for PFAS degradation.

Ali is a PhD Researcher in Bioinformatics at the University of Campania “Luigi Vanvitelli”, Italy. His doctoral research focuses on computational drug discovery and cancer genomics, with particular interests in protein conformational dynamics, allosteric regulation and transcriptomic approaches for identifying DNA damage response vulnerabilities in ALT-positive tumours.
